metadata.description: Daniel Rosehill's public plugins adapted for ChatGPT: instruction-only Agent Skills that work within ChatGPT's current plugin support. Fuller Claude Code versions are in danielrosehill/Claude-Code-Plugins.

plugins.name: israel-research
plugins.description: Israel-specific research and know-how: Kol Zchut rights and entitlements, Home Front Command guidelines, NSC travel warnings, medicines in the Israeli system, which office handles what, phone-number quirks, Shabbat-relative opening hours, salary conversion, and shopping (Zap price checks, personal-import VAT, plug and voltage compatibility, white-label brands). Instruction-only; web search and fetch.

plugins.name: rtl-conformity
plugins.description: Right-to-left conformity for Hebrew, Arabic, Farsi and Urdu across email (Gmail, Resend), Google Docs, Sheets, Slides and Drive, calendar events, and generated files (Word, PDF, Excel, CSV, charts): explicit direction, isolated numbers and dates, Israeli formatting conventions, read-back checks. Instruction-only.
